Round129D.genuine_one_step_adjoint_expansion.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] (mu : Measure (C K))
  (phi h : C K → ℂ) (x : C K) (hi : ∀ n ≤ 2, Integrable (fun g => logMoment K n phi g * h (g⁻¹ * x)) mu) :
